status: model: every expected value is computed by hs_game_sdk.mark1_automation_model from the inputs beside it. The interval's shape and the 0.25 s floor are static reading and measured (RDM 7.1, 7.5). The replenish unit 0.874 (mana a second per unit of id 42's answer) is measured in process by Stats live 3's regen-units, and the drain divides by it, so each automated skill takes a true 1% of maximum mana a second; that per-second rate is the arithmetic's, not re-measured live. The unit-1 drain cases read the answer as mana a second (R - n x 1% x M), the unit-0.874 cases are the shipped arithmetic (R - n x 1% x M / 0.874). The 1.0 s base cast time, the 1500 maximum and the 30 baseline replenish are assumptions.
source: docs/models/mark1-automation-spec.md; hs-game-sdk/python/hs_game_sdk/mark1_automation_model.py; checked by tests/test_mark1_automation_model.py (hub) and by ForgePact's test_mark1_priority_behavior.py (interval, within 1 ms) and test_mark1_cost_behavior.py (drain, maxmana)

units.percent: % of maximum mana per second per automated skill
units.unit: mana per second one unit of id 42's answer is (0.874 measured, Stats live 3; 1 reads the answer as mana per second)
units.expected_drain: id-42 units: percent of max_mana divided by unit (mana per second at unit 1)
units.original: the game's own answer for the dispatcher id (42 for drain, 37 for maxmana)
units.cut_pct: % of maximum mana per automated skill
